_comment: Checks whose automatic fixes must never be applied in this repository.
Each entry is here because its fix-it broke the build, and the reason is structural
rather than a one-off - so a future run would break it again.
Diagnostics from these checks are still reported; only the automatic rewrite is off.

misc-non-private-member-variables-in-cla: The handle types in source/rhi/handles.cppm are deliberate aggregates: a public
`Index` is what lets them be built with designated initialisers and passed by value
like any other trivially copyable id. Making it private turns them into non-aggregates
and every construction site stops compiling.
_note: misc-include-cleaner is not listed here: it is disabled outright in .clang-tidy,
because its reports are unfixable in this project rather than merely unwanted.
